Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, "Mark Cagnolatti >>" <VampC...@AOL.COM> wrote:
> I have a few questions I need some answers to for the upcoming NYC tourney.
>
> 1. Dimple and Lucretia are both in torpor. Dimple attempts to leave.
>
> Can Lucretia assume the action with mask of 1K?

No. Vampires in torpor can only play action modifiers when they
are acting.

> If so sho pays?
> Can Dimple pay if Lucretia has no blood?

Moot.

> Can Dimple undertake the action with no blood and have it assumed by
> Lucretia with blood?

No. You can never initiate an action that you cannot pay the cost for.

> Could Lucretia cloak Dimple?

No, since that is another example of an action modifier played by
a non-acting minion (which cannnot be played by a vampire in Torpor).

> 2. Can the following be done during the Prisci sub-vote:
>
> Vote pushing
> Action Modifiers by an acting Priscus
> Reactions by another Priscus
> Is Mods and reacts can be played, can tehse be duplicated during the normal
> vote. Logic would seem to indicate that, being a separate vote, there is
> no reason why someone could not make a second bewitching oration in favor
> of the motion.

Only Prisci votes can be cast in the Prisci sub vote (i.e., the vote
received for being a Priscus plus any vote that says it is used in
the Prisci Vote). Other votes sources, including the Edge and
Political Action cards, cannot be used. [Sabbat rulesheet: "The
Prisci Vote" - "Only these Priscus votes may be used in this
sub-vote"]

> 3.If Catatonic fear deals damage at the superior after combat, does that
> not by comparison drastically reduce it's power as compared with Drawing
> out the beast?

No, since CF ends combat whereas DotB increases the opponent's hand
damage.

>
> 4. The posting says that a minion may play intercept producing cards if the
> intercept does not exceed the stealth.

"... if intercept is needed. (i.e., stealth exceeds intercept)"

> Can they be played if both are
> equal? My predator plays arson - Can I play Enhanced senses just to cycle?

No, because you do not need intercept.

> 5. After 30+ pages of rulings, clarifications and errata, and this is just
> a query, I don't mean to be argumentative, is it really too complex to say
> that a vampire who changes status from camarilla to non-camarilla (or
> Sabbat to non-Sabbat) loses titles formerly held? The ruling has already
> been passed about vampires with innnate votes - to wit that these are lost
> - can we not expand this to include the above?

Innate votes are not lost unless a new title is gained.
Changing sects (cam -> non-Cam or vice-versa) is not sufficient.

Figuring out what to do with titles when after a sect change is
easy in some cases, hard in others. It happens infrequently enough
to warrant leaving it alone rather than muddy the issue to handle
the hard cases.

> 6. If a vampire cannot burn enough blood for blood to water, is there no
> other deleterious effect? I thought there was a ruling, long ago, perhaps
> I am wrong, that such a vampire was torpored...

All vampires ignore "burn blood" effects once they are reduced
to zero blood. Torpor only follows from damage.

> 7. Cloak the gathering, Eagles sight and cats guidance: Is it the case that
> none of these can be played at inferior and superior for the same action?

... by the same minion, yes.
